title: lantana aculeata f. rubella
intro: Lantana aculeata f. rubella, commonly known as red button lantana, is a shrub-like plant belonging to the Verbenaceae family, characterized by its vibrant red flowers and sharp thorns. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Lantana aculeata f. rubella include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off pathogens, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in various pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications.
